name: NocoDB
description: NocoDB turns any SQL database into a smart spreadsheet. It offers a rich grid, kanban, and gallery views, plus forms, automations, and a REST or GraphQL API generated on the fly. A compelling bridge for teams that want Airtable-style tooling without surrendering their data.
highlights: Connect an existing SQL database or start fresh
Grid, kanban, calendar, and gallery views
Generated REST and GraphQL APIs per table
curatorNote: NocoDB does what many tools only promise: it keeps your data portable while giving you a polished interface. The generated API is a nice bonus for internal tooling.
